why_appended: The pro-forma capitalised GROSS rent. Cap rates apply to NOI, so value was overstated by 1/(1-opex) ~ 1.5x, which made almost every parcel pencil and hid the model's real sensitivities. Added OPEX_RATIO=0.35 and deducted it before capitalising. Structural figures (elmwood_parcels, commercial_parcels, commercial_acres) are UNCHANGED — only calibration-dependent figures moved.
note: METHOD DEMO — calibration figures remain placeholder-derived. The result is now KNIFE-EDGE around OPEX_RATIO: 30% opex and the strip pencils, 35% and it does not. That input now deserves the scrutiny land wrongly received.
land_basis_test_2026_09_08: A market land surface built from 4,187 parcels transferred 2024+ (Prop-13 resets assessment to market on sale) put Elmwood at $63.98/sqft vs $25.63 assessed, 2.5x. Substituting it changed baseline_feasible by ONE parcel. Break-even land is $505/sqft under baseline zoning, so both bases are 1-2% of it. LAND WAS NEVER BINDING — the prior baseline's stated expectation was disproved.
